extracted.name: Coconut Date Bars
extracted.description: Coconut date bars are filled with almonds and cashews for an easy, on-the-go snack filled with protein giving you energy for hiking or a busy day.
instruction_lines: Blend almonds and coconut in a food processor; add dates and pulse until combined. Add cashews and coconut oil; pulse until mixture is thick and sticks together. Transfer to a sheet of waxed paper; form into a square, folding sides of waxed paper over the top. Refrigerate until solid, at least 30 minutes.
